sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:105938
Court No. - 65

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 23140 of 2025
Applicant :- Ajeet Kumar Yadav

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Sanjay Kumar Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.
1.
List has been revised.

2. Heard Sri Sanjay Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Anit Kumar Shukla,
learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.
Applicant seeks bail in Case Crime No. 123 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304B, 323 IPC and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Chandwak, District Jaunpur, during the pendency of trial.
4. As per prosecution story, marriage of the applicant was solemnized with the deceased person as per Hindu rites on 15.06.2019.
The applicant and other family members are stated to have subjected her to cruelty for demand of dowry thereby led her to death on 07.05.2024 at about 11 p.m.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the applicant has argued that the applicant is absolutely innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
He has nothing to do with the said offence as alleged in the FIR.
The FIR is delayed by one day and there is no explanation of the said delay caused.
6. It is next stated that it is a clear cut case of false implication.

At the time of FIR, the applicant was attending his duties being employed at Victory Plant & Machinery Pvt. Ltd. Mumbai, Nashik Road,
Thane, Maharashtra.

entities.text: Victory Plant & Machinery Pvt. Ltd. Mumbai
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The said certificate of the employer has been filed as Annexure-11 to the affidavit filed with the bail application.
The cause of death has been found to be asphyxia as a result of ante mortem hanging.
There is no particular demand of dowry in the FIR, as such the applicant is entitled for bail.
7. There is no criminal history of the applicant.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 07.10.2024 and he is ready to cooperate with trial.
In case, the applicant is released on bail, he will not misuse the liberty of bail.

8. Per contra, learned AGA has vehemently opposed the bail application but unable to dispute the submissions raised by the learned counsel for the applicant and also the fact that the applicant has no criminal history.

9. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the delay in institution of the FIR coupled by the fact that there is no particular demand of dowry in the FIR, I find it a fit case to release the applicant on bail.
The bail application is allowed.

10. Let the applicant- Ajeet Kumar Yadav, who is involved in aforementioned case crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
i) The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii) The applicantshall not pressurise/intimidate with the prosecution witnesses.
iii) The applicantshall appear before the trial court on the date fixed.
11. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

12. It is made clear that observations made in granting bail to the applicant shall not in any way affect the learned trial Judge in forming his independent opinion based on the testimony of the witnesses.

Order Date :- 7.7.2025 Sumit S (Justice Krishan Pahal)
